svg.title: Nest Life ELEGOO Mega visual wiring guide
svg.desc: Illustrated wiring guide showing Mega 2560 pins, breadboard rails, joystick, ultrasonic module, GY-521 through a bidirectional level shifter, two buttons, photoresistor and LEDs.
svg.text: Unplug USB before wiring. Follow pin labels on your own modules; layouts may vary.
Rows on each side are connected in groups of five.
See the numbered row map below before placing wires.
GY VCC: +5 V only if its onboard regulator is verified.
Otherwise use a suitable regulated 3.3 V supply.
Each numbered row has two separate strips: LEFT (a–e) and RIGHT (f–j).
LED long leg = anode (+); short leg / flat edge = cathode (−). Never omit the resistors.
1 Check 5 V and GND are not shorted.
2 Check the GY-521 regulator and use
3 Wire joystick and sensors by pin label.
4 Place buttons across the center gap.
6 Connect USB and upload the firmware.
7 Test one component at a time.
The optional buzzer is omitted here;
see the pin table for D10 wiring.
Colored wires show breadboard power. Other connections are identified by pin and row labels for readability.
